$comment: Recruitable companions (spec §6; campaign bible DESIGN.md §11). Built from SRD rules like the hero (Quick Build plan + species/background), levelled to the party's level on joining. status/loyalty flags follow DESIGN §11 (loyalty 0–100, starts 50). Arc 2 companions (DESIGN_ARC2 §9) list `arcs`: only adventures of those arcs may recruit them (absent = any arc).

companions.name: Ser Corwin Ashvale
companions.personality: Earnest, stubborn and dry-humoured; ashamed of his dismissal but never mopes.
companions.goal: Prove that the Dawn Lance's creed matters more than its orders, and be reinstated.
companions.voice: Clipped and formal, softening as trust grows.
banter: A knight keeps his word even when no one is watching. Especially then.
Stay behind me when the steel comes out.
My mentor used to say an oath is a promise to your future self.
I have slept in worse places. Not many, but some.
grumbles: I follow you because I said I would. Do not make me regret it.
This is not what the Lance would do.

companions.name: Nettle
companions.personality: Blunt, funny and fearless around the sick; sharp around authority. Hums while healing.
companions.goal: Find a true cure for the Whispering Sickness.
companions.voice: Quick fen-dialect; swears by roots and rot.
banter: Rot and roots, that smell is either supper or a corpse.
Sit still, I'm not done patching you.
Grandmother Wick says the fen remembers everyone who walks it.
You breathe too loud for sneaking, you know.
grumbles: Keep this up and I'm walking back to the stilts.
I've met leeches with better manners.

companions.name: Rook Marrowby
companions.personality: Charming, evasive, loyal only once it costs him something.
companions.goal: Stay free and stay rich — or so he says.
banter: Relax. If this were a trap, I'd be standing somewhere else.
Everything has a price. Most people just don't know theirs yet.
Nice purse. Kidding. Mostly.
Gullhaven had better food. And worse company. Well — different company.
grumbles: You're making this very easy to walk away from.
Remind me why I'm still here?

companions.name: Aurek Vell
companions.personality: Precise, courteous, haunted by what his family has done.
companions.goal: Understand his aunt — and stop her.
banter: Fascinating. Terrible, but fascinating.
My aunt would call this 'an inefficient use of mercy'. I call it the point.
There is a pattern here. Give me a moment.
I read about places like this. The books were kinder.
grumbles: I did not leave my family to follow someone who acts like them.
We are drifting from the reason I came.

companions.name: Brannoc Stonecount
companions.personality: Gruff, patient and scrupulously fair; weighs every word as if it were coin, and laughs like a dropped anvil.
companions.goal: Give the Ironvault back its honour, and find his father's assay seal in the hollow tenth.
companions.voice: Slow Deepanvil burr; counts under his breath when angry.
banter: Korrath weighs the hand that strikes as well as the blow.
Gold that lies is worse than no gold at all.
My father could tell true silver by its ring across a market square.
Bite it. Weigh it. Then trust it. In that order.
grumbles: A fair deal has two honest hands. I am counting yours.
This is how the ledger goes hollow: one easy lie at a time.

companions.name: Sister Ilse Varn
companions.personality: Soft-spoken, sleepless and stubbornly kind; writes down every dream before breakfast.
companions.goal: Read the Book of the Unmade and give one bought face back to its owner.
companions.voice: Quiet temple Common; trails off mid-sentence when a dream returns.
banter: I dreamed of a forge last night. It was asleep, and it was hungry.
Every face they sell belonged to someone who was loved.
Veyra keeps the dreams we forget. I try to keep the rest.
Write it down. Memory is the first thing they steal.
grumbles: I did not come to watch people become ledger entries.
Please. Think about who pays for this.

companions.name: Wren Thistle
companions.personality: Quick, cheerful and shameless at the table; cold as sea ice to anyone who cheats her.
companions.goal: Get even with the launderer who stiffed her, then win back her rematch with Salt.
companions.voice: Fast Brinescatter patter; calls everyone 'friend' right up until she doesn't.
banter: Fennick loves a bold bet. He just doesn't pay out on stupid ones.
Loaded dice are honest, friend. They always tell you who's cheating.
I never steal from anyone who couldn't afford to lose it. Usually.
Double or nothing? No? Your loss.
grumbles: You keep handing people to the law and I'll start counting the exits.
I've walked out of better games than this.
